name: Camp Belknap
description_short: Camp Belknap is a non-profit overnight camp for boys ages 8-16 on Lake Winnipesaukee in New Hampshire. It runs four two-week sessions, plus a one-week fifth session for ages 8-12.
refund_policy_summary: The $300 registration fee is non-refundable. The page gives no other refund terms.

warnings: Tuition is tiered, and families choose their tier. Session prices shown are Tier One (the 'true cost'): $3,375 for two weeks and $1,675 for one week. Tier Two costs $2,475 for two weeks and $1,275 for one week. All totals include a non-refundable $300 registration fee and a store deposit ($50 or $25).
Eight-year-olds can attend Sessions 1-4 only if an older brother is a current camper in the same session. They must turn 8 before June 1.
Sixteen-year-olds must still be 16 through the end of Session 4 (Aug. 21, 2027).
Returning campers get acceptance priority until November 12, 2026. A waitlist is kept, and submitting an application does not guarantee a spot.
A 4-week stay is possible by combining Sessions 1 & 2 or 3 & 4. The page gives no separate 4-week price.
Some linked documents still refer to 2024 or 2026 (policies, medication instructions, communicable disease plan, pre-camp checklist).
Registration starts with an inquiry form. Applications are then sent out; there is no direct booking.
